work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Indult CXCIII grants the canons of Prato cathedral a violet collar and a small gold cross within their diocese; LF42119 → LF42125 across page number 287 LF42122; LF42187 → LF42196 across own provenance LF42190 and page number 288 LF42193; complete 4 December 1838 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF42114–42114; the source closing at LF42213–42216 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub an- nulo piscatoris die quarta decembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo octavo, pontificatus Nostri anno octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
